{"id":2062180841,"question_id":3838,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 week, 6 days","timestamp":1783625907,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"54 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2062180841/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Path Existence Queries in a Graph I","memory":"236 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<bool> pathExistenceQueries(int n, vector<int>& nums, int maxDiff, vector<vector<int>>& queries) {\n        vector<bool>ans;\n        vector<int>component(n ,-1);\n        component[0] = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if((nums[i] - nums[i-1]) <= maxDiff) component[i] = component[i-1];\n            else component[i] = (component[i-1] == -1) ? 0 : (component[i-1] + 1);\n        }\n\n        for(auto it : queries)\n        {\n            int u = it[0];\n            int v = it[1];\n\n            if((u == v) or (component[u] == component[v])) ans.push_back(true);\n            else ans.push_back(false);\n        }\n        \n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"path-existence-queries-in-a-graph-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2311}
